game.name: James Cameron's Avatar : The Game (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
game.desc: James Cameron's Avatar: The Game for Xbox 360 is an action game directly adapted from the film of the same name. The game allows you to explore the mysterious jungle of the planet Pandora where the Na'vis, an alien race with blue skin, live. Soon, however, you'll have to choose sides and fight as a human soldier or as a Na'vi. A multiplayer mode with up to 16 players is also available.
